maddeler.e:
نتصادر (form VI)
# نَتَصَادَرُ (nataṣādaru) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
# نَتَصَادَرَ (nataṣādara) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
# نَتَصَادَرْ (nataṣādar) /na.ta.sˤaː.dar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَادَرَ (taṣādara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
